title: Integrations found for one system (integration-tracer)
description: What one system's evidence pack shows: the integrations it takes part in, with the automations that carry each one and the objects they touch, and the systems named only behind it.

from.description: Where the data starts: 'org' (the Salesforce org), a system id from the pack, or the name of a system in newSystems.

to.description: Where the data arrives, as for 'from'.

via.description: The middleware the data passes through (a middleware system id, or a newSystems name marked middleware); left out when the exchange is direct.

whatMoves.description: What the exchange carries, in business words, short enough for a line label: 'Invoices and credit notes', 'Tasks', 'Space admins'.

technology.description: The mechanism the evidence shows: 'Apex callout', 'Named credential callout', 'Platform event', 'Connected app (API)', 'Managed package'.

pattern.description: A pattern_id from the plugin's data/integration-patterns.csv, when the evidence settles it.

automations.description: nodeIds of the pack's automations that carry this exchange.

objects.description: API names of the objects those automations read, write or run on for this exchange, as the pack lists them.

evidence.description: Why: the automation descriptions, names, key fields or inventory items the call rests on, quoted short.

inferred.description: true when no automation or description states the exchange and it is worked out from the inventory alone (a connected app, a credential).

name.description: The system as people name it.

via.description: The middleware system id it is reached through.

searchTerms.description: Distinctive words that name it in Flow and Apex source (never an everyday word).
